tagline: Fast, lightweight BitTorrent client — traffic routed through your Gluetun VPN tunnel.
description: Transmission is a simple, lightweight BitTorrent client with a web UI. This package routes all of its network traffic through the Gluetun VPN container (network mode: container:gluetun) so your torrents go through your VPN, and it relies on the torrent ports opened on Gluetun.

tips.before_install: Requires the "Gluetun VPN" app from this store to be installed and configured first — this app's traffic depends on it. Downloads are saved to /media/Main-Storage/Downloads/transmission. The web UI is reachable on port 9091, which Gluetun publishes.

author: dieppon
title: Transmission
